activeQuestion.prompt: Choose the best word or sentence for blank [141].
activeQuestion.promptZh: 請選出最適合填入空格 [141] 的字詞或句子。

options.text: No bicycles are allowed inside the workshop.
options.zh: 不得將自行車帶入工作坊場地。
options.whyZh: 前文要求攜帶自行車，並安排現場檢查與實作。

options.text: If a bicycle needs a new part, its owner will be told what to purchase.
options.zh: 若自行車需要新零件，車主會被告知應購買什麼。
options.whyZh: 接續講師先檢查的安排，也呼應現場不供應替換零件。

options.text: Every participant must buy a new bicycle before arriving.
options.zh: 每位參加者都必須先購買新自行車。
options.whyZh: 活動是維修自備自行車，沒有要求購買新車。

options.text: The instructor will conduct the entire class by email.
options.zh: 講師將全程透過電子郵件授課。
options.whyZh: 與現場實作及逐車檢查的安排矛盾。

group.title: Community repair workshop
group.passage:
The community center will host a bicycle repair workshop this Saturday from 9 a.m. to noon. Participants will learn how to adjust brakes and repair a flat tire. No previous repair [139] ____ is necessary.

Please bring your own bicycle. Tools will be provided, [140] ____ helmets and replacement parts will not. The instructor will inspect each bicycle before the practical session begins. [141] ____

The class is limited to twelve people, so registration is [142] ____. Reserve a place through the community center website by Thursday evening.

社區中心將於本週六上午九點至中午舉辦自行車維修工作坊。參加者將學習如何調整煞車及修補漏氣輪胎。不需要任何既有的維修 [139] ____。

請攜帶自己的自行車。現場提供工具，[140] ____ 不提供安全帽與替換零件。實作開始前，講師會檢查每台自行車。[141] ____
